questions.question:
What will the value of the following expression be?

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

B - Brackets

O - Of

D - Division

M - Multiplication

A - Addition

S - Subtraction

Preference will be done on the basis of the letter coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculations:**

20 – [15 – {4 – (8 – 6 + 3)}]

= 20 - [15 - {4 - (11 - 6)}]

= 20 - [15 - {4 - 5}]

= 20 - [15 - {- 1}]

= 20 - [15 + 1 ]

= 20 - 16

= 4

**Hence, The value is 4.**

questions.question: The best method to dispose of biological wastes from hospitals is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**incineration**__.

__
 
• The best method to dispose of biological wastes from hospitals is **incineration**.
 
• Incineration is a waste treatment process that involves the combustion of substances contained in **waste materials**. 
 
• Industrial plants for waste incineration are commonly referred to as **waste-to-energy** facilities. 
 
• Incineration and other high-temperature waste treatment systems are described as "**thermal treatment**".
 
• Incineration of waste materials converts the waste into **ash, flue gas and heat**.
 
• The **ash** is mostly formed by the inorganic constituents of the waste and may take the form of solid lumps or particulates carried by the flue gas.
 
• The flue gases must be cleaned of **gaseous and particulate pollutants** before they are dispersed into the atmosphere.
 
• In some cases, the heat that is generated by incineration can be used to generate **electric power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decomposition** or rot is the process by which dead organic substances are broken down into simpler organic or inorganic matter such as carbon dioxide, water, simple sugars and mineral salts. 
 
• The daily operation at a Class 3 landfill includes dumping of waste into a specific area of the **landfill** - called a working face - followed by compaction (crushing) of the waste and then covering of the waste with soil. Waste is dumped into an open area of the landfill called a cell.
 
• **Burning** waste is usually an environmentally poor waste management option because potential resources are lost and it can cause air, land and water pollution.

questions.question: How many factors of 2² × 3¹ × 5² × 7¹ are divisible by 50 but not by 100?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number N = 2² × 3¹ × 5² × 7¹

For factors divisible by **50** (2¹ × 5²) but not by **100** (2² × 5²), the factor must contain exactly **2¹** and **5²**.

Required factors = (power of 2 is fixed at 1) × (power of 3 can be 0 or 1) × (power of 5 is fixed at 2) × (power of 7 can be 0 or 1)

Number of factors = 1 × (1 + 1) × 1 × (1 + 1) = 1 × 2 × 1 × 2 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** N = 2² × 3¹ × 5² × 7¹

**Formula:** If N = ap × bq × cr, total factors = (p+1)(q+1)(r+1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1b2f29ddfa5ab156da786a7b4031d030598bf62a22a7ab1b7d9b3e0c5271366.png] 

⇒ Divisible by 50 means the factor must have at least 2¹ and 5².

⇒ Not divisible by 100 means the factor cannot have 2² or higher (if available) along with 5².

⇒ In N = 2² × 3¹ × 5² × 7¹, the exponent of 2 must be exactly 1.

⇒ The exponent of 5 must be exactly 2 (as 5² is the maximum available and minimum required).

⇒ The exponents of 3 and 7 can be anything from 0 to their respective maximums.

⇒ Possible exponents for 2: {1} → 1 choice

⇒ Possible exponents for 5: {2} → 1 choice

⇒ Possible exponents for 3: {0, 1} → 2 choices

⇒ Possible exponents for 7: {0, 1} → 2 choices

⇒ Total factors = 1 × 1 × 2 × 2 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Number of Factors

For a number N = pa × qb × rc, total factors = (a+1)(b+1)(c+1).

Factors Divisible by a Number k

Divide N by k first: N/k = M. The number of factors of N divisible by k is equal to the total number of factors of M.

Prime Factorization

Always express the number in the form of powers of prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, etc.) before applying factor formulas.</p
